description: Royal Caribbean Group is a vacation industry leader, owning and operating three global cruise vacation brands, Royal Caribbean, Celebrity Cruises and Silversea, and it also owns a 50 percent joint venture interest in TUI Cruises GmbH, which operates the German brands TUI Cruises and Hapag-Lloyd Cruises, accounted for under the equity method of accounting. Together its Global Brands and Partner Brands have a combined fleet of 69 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 179,720 berths as of December 31, 2025, and its ships offer a selection of worldwide itineraries that call on more than 1,000 destinations on all seven continents, with Silversea being an ultra luxury and expedition travel brand featuring smaller ships, high standards of accommodations, fine dining, personalized service and exotic itineraries, operating 12 ships with an aggregate capacity of approximately 5,500 berths, and it also owns a growing portfolio of private land-based destinations, including its Perfect Day and Royal Beach Club collections, with its competitive edge grounded in its focus on innovation, best evidenced in the quality and variety of ships in its fleet.
